job.title: SAP BTP Architect
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP BTP Architect to join a Tier 1 global consultancy supporting a major Phase 2 SAP S/4HANA implementation for a great client in New Zealand.
This is a permanent opportunity for an architect who enjoys working on large-scale SAP transformation programs and wants to play a key role in shaping the client’s BTP architecture and integration landscape.
About the role You will work closely with the client, SAP functional teams and technical stakeholders to design and deliver scalable SAP BTP solutions as part of the ongoing S/4HANA transformation.
Key responsibilities include:
  • Define and govern SAP BTP architecture and solution design
  • Design integration solutions across SAP and non-SAP platforms
  • Support the Phase 2 S/4HANA implementation and broader transformation roadmap
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to delivery teams
  • Work with senior client stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective solutions
  • Drive best practice across integration, extension and BTP services
About you We’re looking for someone with:
  • Strong SAP BTP architecture experience
  • Solid SAP S/4HANA implementation experience
  • Strong knowledge of SAP Integration Suite and SAP Cloud technologies
  • Experience designing enterprise integration and extension architectures
  • Excellent stakeholder and communication skills
  • Experience working on large SAP transformation programs
  • The ability to operate comfortably at both strategic and hands-on technical levels
You must be currently based in or willing to relocate to New Zealand to be considered for this role.
The opportunity
  • Permanent position with a Tier 1 consultancy
  • Major SAP S/4HANA transformation program
  • Great client and strong project environment
  • Opportunity to influence architecture during Phase 2
  • Long-term career and development opportunities
If you’re an experienced SAP BTP Architect looking for your next permanent opportunity in New Zealand, we’d love to hear from you.
